description: Afforestation/reforestation (A/R) experiment in a warmer world. Same as `scen7-h-SST`, except land use is fixed at a present-day (2021) monthly climatology, and BVOC, fire and dust emissions are prescribed from `scen7-h-SST-vlLU`. Compare with `scen7-h-SST-vlLU` for the surface-albedo effect of A/R, and with `scen7-h-SST-pdLU-BFD` for the effect via BVOC, fire and dust emissions.
